angles.label: Scene of Reading the Paper
angles.description: Separate the circumstances in which Yoon Jeong-hu read the paper to his mother and tried to finish before his brother arrived.

angles.label: Confirming the Mother's Wishes
angles.description: Ask whether the mother understood the contents of the will and expressed her wishes by herself.

angles.label: Visit Frequency in Her Final Year
angles.description: Examine how Yoon Jung-hoo's increased visits and time spent connect to the discussion of the will.

angles.label: Switch of Care Worker
angles.description: Examine whether the change of the assigned care worker before notarisation lined up with the will procedure.

angles.label: Timing and Procedure of Notarisation
angles.description: Match the day of notarisation, the document preparation, and the mother's state in chronological order.

angles.label: The Scene of the Paper Being Read Aloud
angles.description: Separate the situation in which Yoon Jung-hoo read the paper aloud to their mother and tried to wrap up before his elder brother arrived.

angles.label: Responsibility for Forgery
angles.description: Confirm responsibility for handling the mother's document, regardless of motive.

angles.label: Notary's Memo Record
angles.description: Confirm the mother's state, any number confusion, and the procedural sequence noted on the day of notarisation.

angles.label: Difference Between the Handwritten Draft and the Notarised Copy
angles.description: Ask why the ratio differs between the handwritten draft and the notarised copy.

angles.label: The Paradox of the Direction of the Change
angles.description: Separate the point where the direction of the change does not match a conventional reading of greed.

angles.label: Responsibility for Tampering
angles.description: Whatever the motive, confirm the responsibility for any handling of the mother's document.

angles.label: The Older Brother's Pride and Silence
angles.description: Confirm whether the silence about the money was protection or deception.

angles.label: Monthly Deposit Flow
angles.description: Examine, step by step, the actual nature of the recurring deposits made into the mother's account.

angles.label: Routing Through the Mother's Account
angles.description: Examine the structure that made the money appear to be in the mother's name, and the misunderstanding it caused.

angles.label: Support During the Factory Crisis
angles.description: Ask about the flow during the factory's difficult period and how its origin was perceived.

angles.label: The Elder Brother's Pride and Silence
angles.description: Examine whether keeping silent about the money was protection or deception.

angles.label: Connection to the Will Change
angles.description: Ask how the sensitive family circumstances connected to the judgment behind the will change.

angles.label: When the Diary Was Found
angles.description: Ask when Yoon Jung-hoo first saw the mother's diary and what he confirmed.

angles.label: Sealed Family Record
angles.description: Without opening the specific contents recklessly, press only on the effect of the sealed family record.

angles.label: Reason for the Silence
angles.description: Examine whom the silence — knowing yet not telling — protected and whom it excluded.

angles.label: Link to the Will Change
angles.description: Ask how the sensitive family circumstances connected to the decision to change the will.

angles.label: Shared Responsibility of the Two Brothers
angles.description: Sort out the brothers' different forms of responsibility together, not as a one-sided villain structure.

angles.label: Eldest-Son Entitlement Assumed as Inheritance
angles.description: Look at the responsibility Yoon Tae-seong bears for reading care and eldest-son standing as a right to inherit.

angles.label: Control Under the Justification of Protection
angles.description: Look at the responsibility Yoon Jung-hoo bears for adjusting the mother's wishes under the justification of protection.

angles.label: The Place of the Mother's Wishes
angles.description: Confirm how the mother's actual wishes vanished between the two sons' interpretations.

angles.label: Joint Responsibility of the Two Brothers
angles.description: Not a one-sided villain frame, but a record of the two different forms of responsibility, organised together.
